data.one_liner: File picker input field for the flutter_form_builder package.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FormBuilderFilePicker widget that integrates file picking capabilities directly into flutter_form_builder forms. It supports multiple file types, automatic permission handling, and image previews.
use_when: You are building forms with flutter_form_builder and need file or image upload inputs.
You want automatic permission handling for picking files across mobile and desktop platforms.
avoid_when: You are not using the flutter_form_builder ecosystem in your application.
You only need standalone file picking functionality without form state management.
strengths: Supports multiple file types and custom selectors via TypeSelector
weaknesses: Strictly bound to the flutter_form_builder package dependency
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific setup as documented by the underlying file_picker package.
data.minimal_example:
FormBuilderFilePicker(
  name: "images",
  decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: "Attachments"),
  maxFiles: null,
  previewImages: true,
  onChanged: (val) => print(val),
)
